description_en: Modifies all parameters of a custom cloud computer template
description_zh: 修改自定义云电脑模板的全部参数
name: ModifyTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template ID
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the template. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 126 characters in length.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Periods (.) are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
模板的名称。必须符合以下要求：

长度2~126个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
可以包含字母、数字、汉字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或短划线（-），不支持点号（.）
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the template. The description must meet the following requirements:

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, spaces, and special characters. Line breaks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
模板的描述。必须符合以下要求：

长度2~256个字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
支持中文、英文、数字、空格和特殊符号，使用回车换行
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 40 to 500. The value must be a multiple of 10.

The system cloud disk size cannot be smaller than the size of the configured image
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘大小。单位：GiB。取值范围: 40~500，每10GiB为一个步长。

系统盘大小不能小于配置的镜像大小
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the system cloud disk.

Only high frequency and graphics cloud computer specifications support ESSD cloud disks
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘类型。

只有高主频和图形型的云电脑规格支持ESSD类型的磁盘
parameters.name: system_disk_performance_level

fields.help_en: The performance level of the data cloud disk. Default value: `AutoPL`
fields.help_zh: 数据盘性能等级，默认为`AutoPL`
fields.name: performance_level

fields.help_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 40 to 2040. The value must be a multiple of 10
fields.help_zh: 数据盘大小。单位：GiB。输入值范围: 40~2040GiB，每10GiB为一个步长
fields.name: size

parameters.help_en: The system cloud disk performance level
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘性能等级
parameters.name: data_disk_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer image. You can query the ID on the Image Management page. System images and custom images are supported
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑镜像ID，可以从镜像管理页面查询，支持系统镜像、自定义镜像等类型
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the global policy
parameters.help_zh: 全局类型的策略ID
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The default language that is set when the cloud computer starts. This parameter takes effect only when a system image is used to create the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑启动时设置的默认语言，仅在使用系统镜像创建云电脑的场景下生效
parameters.name: default_language

parameters.help_en: The configuration group ID
parameters.help_zh: 配置组ID
parameters.name: timer_group_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The tags of the cloud computer in key-value format. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑标签。Key-Value格式。最多可传入20个标签
parameters.name: resource_tag_list

fields.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
fields.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
fields.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy
fields.name: snapshot_policy_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable disk encryption
fields.help_zh: 是否开启磁盘加密功能
fields.name: volume_encryption_enable

fields.help_en: The ID of the KMS key used when disk encryption is enabled
fields.help_zh: 开启磁盘加密的情况下使用的KMS的密钥ID
fields.name: volume_encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
The region-specific template configurations. You can specify multiple configurations. The configuration that matches the specific region is used.

You can specify configurations for up to 20 regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域化的模板信息配置， 支持配置多个。 使用时会根据具体的地域匹配。

最多支持20个地域的配置
parameters.name: region_config_list

parameters.help_en: The site configuration management
parameters.help_zh: 区域配置管理
parameters.name: site_config_list

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑的付费类型
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the subscription cloud computer. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`. The unit is specified by `PeriodUnit`.
If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 6
If `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`, valid values:
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 4
    - 5
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月共享型云电脑的购买时长。当参数`ChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。
如果`PeriodUnit`为`Month`，该参数的取值范围：
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 6
如果`PeriodUnit`为`Year`，该参数的取值范围：
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 4
    - 5
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration for the subscription billing method
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月计费方式的时长单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether automatic payment is enabled for the subscription order
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动支付包年包月订单
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the subscription cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 是否为包年包月共享型云电脑开启自动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The per-user usage duration plan
parameters.help_zh: 单用户使用时长套餐
parameters.name: user_duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically switch to pay-as-you-go billing after the duration plan is used up
parameters.help_zh: 时长包用尽后是否自动转为按量付费继续使用
parameters.name: post_paid_after_used_up

Code.description_en: The execution result. A value of `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 执行结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned when Code is `success`
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当Code为`success`时，不返回该参数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values: true: The operation was successful. false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败
